basis.principle: Recovery policy is a V5 safety policy derived from verified action contracts; it is not a claim that the game exposes transactional rollback.

globalRules.preSendException: Only when durable journal evidence proves SEND_NOT_ATTEMPTED may the scheduler re-attempt the same intent after fresh admission.

committed: Fresh authoritative observations satisfy every action-contract postcondition for the intended mutation.
All relevant effect domains are consistent with the intended delta and contain no contradictory evidence.
notApplied: Positive fresh evidence shows every relevant effect domain still equals the pinned pre-state.
No competing mutation under the held resource/fencing scope can explain an unseen equivalent change.
partial: Only a strict subset of intended postconditions/effect-domain deltas is observed; do not complete or resend the original intent.
Create a new remainder plan only after the partial state is itself reconciled and journaled.
stillPending: Only classify STILL_PENDING when authoritative live state explicitly exposes an in-progress marker for this action; absence of a result alone is not pending proof.
unresolved: Evidence is stale, unavailable, contradictory, or insufficient to distinguish applied from not-applied.

reobserveSources: fresh inventory with exact target/scroll/offering identities and quantities

committed: q.upgrade is absent, the attributable placeholder is resolved, and the exact path-specific terminal target state is proven.
All expected consumable/condition deltas are reconciled: scroll quantity, optional offering, and massproduction condition when used.
A terminal upgrade_fail is accepted as COMMITTED only after inventory proves the correct failure variant: destruction for ordinary uscroll failure, preservation for scroll4/material-offering failure.
Stat-scroll and offering-only paths are committed from stat/grace/property postconditions rather than a supposed level increment.
notApplied: Fresh positive evidence proves the exact target, scroll/offering quantities, relevant conditions and target properties all still match the pinned pre-state.
No attributable q.upgrade or placeholder exists and no server-side path-specific mutation is visible.
partial: Consumables/conditions changed or placeholder/input changed, but the terminal target item/loss/stat/grace state cannot yet be reconciled.
